column1: # Rows db.html.ps.* (line RG T4c, 2026-11-24; T4c2 + PS15b-2 second-lander rows added 2026-11-26): psiblast with -html, NCBI's bytes of formats 0 to 4 and 18 per round (the survey's cases of SURVEY_T4c.md section 1.2: three references, `Results from round N`, the two-part table of a later round with a registry read per part and a description rank per part, `Search has CONVERGED!`, D9 at the very end, query-anchored formats 1 to 4, per-round organism report format 18), -num_iterations 0 to 3, a query without hits, an empty inclusion set, three queries, -num_descriptions 0, -num_alignments 0, -line_length 30, -seg and -lcase_masking (no <font> in psiblast), id kinds and special titles (../db_search/ids/prot_v5, of18/ps_ids, html/pmix_ids, taxfilter/tfp), -in_pssm and -in_msa queries, the registry and environment rows (cwd= run directories of ../db_search/html/rc: repeated ./.ncbirc entry with the posts naming [psiblast], a directory as ./.ncbirc, GETURL_DEBUG, LOCAL_ID, a malformed ./.ncbirc and InitConfig), -subject rows with a registry, and -html with formats 6, 7 and 11 (html ignored). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast); the rows whose stderr holds an exception trace with the local official binary. The covers cell names the survey probe (T/t4c).
